records.notes: Cohort covers 56 franchised Travel Center and Gas and Convenience Center restaurants operated by franchisees for the entire 53-week FY25 period. Excludes 950 freestanding locations, 25 college/university/toll plaza/end-cap/inline/airport locations, and 1 restaurant that did not provide complete revenue data. Revenue definition excludes sales taxes and CJR-approved promotional items but includes gift card redemptions.

notes: Item 19 discloses average revenue for a specific subset of franchised outlets (Travel Center and Gas and Convenience Center format only). The cohort is format-anchored rather than tenure- or performance-anchored, so 'other' is used for cohort_name. All numeric values were clearly legible with no OCR ambiguity. The 56% pct_above_avg corresponds to 28 out of 50 outlets (the document states 28 met/exceeded, and 28/50 = 56%; note outlet count is 56 but only 50 are implied by 28/56 = 50%, suggesting the document may round — the doc explicitly states both 28 and 56%, so both are captured as disclosed).
